constraints.description: Pickup weekday determines the weekend indicator.
constraints.rationale: is_weekend is explicitly derived from pickup_day_of_week: Saturday and Sunday map to 1, and Monday through Friday map to 0.

constraints.description: Final rate code strongly determines the usual trip-origin type.
constraints.rationale: The TLC rate-code semantics align with the observed trip-origin coding: standard and airport/geographic rate codes map to street-hail type 1, while negotiated-fare code 5 maps to dispatch type 2; the small observed exceptions are treated as data inconsistencies rather than additional admissible mappings.
